nodes.label: .`opening reads the job fresh even if detail was on screen`()

.`reconnect retries this session's unresolved prepare once, then reads`()

.`a hint while sending does not re-read`()
.`a hint when idle re-reads and keeps the answers`()

.`a retry that throws resets sending and shows the message`()
.`a read that throws stops loading and shows the message`()
